question: In May 2020, Thierry Delaporte was appointed as the CEO and MD of which of the following companies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wipro.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **CEO and Managing Director** of Wipro Limited is **Thierry Delaporte.**
 
• He is one of the **co-founders of Life Project 4 Youth, **a **nonprofit **devoted to **assisting young adults living in extreme poverty** with their career and **social integration.**
 
• An **Indian multinational organization** called **Wipro Limited **offers **business process, consultancy, and information technology services.**
 
• **Mohamed Premji** founded the business on **December 29, 1945, in Amalner, India,** as** Western India Vegetable Products Limited**, afterwards known as** Wipro.**
 
• It was** originally** established as a** producer of refined and vegetable oils **with the trade names** Kisan, Sunflower, and Camel. **
 
• Wipro Limited 
 
• **Founded:** 29 December 1945

 **Founder**: Muhammed Hashim Premji

 **Headquarters**: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
